summary: Read the complete 37-page markdown conversion, including references and Appendix A. Verified all five estimates against the PDF: arm means, differences, F statistics, and arm counts in Table 3 (pp. 19-20); total analysis counts in Table 2 (p. 17); and p-value bounds in the results text (p. 19). Checked the randomized design, outcome definitions, analysis units, and all requested coding fields against pp. 9-17. Novelty, appropriateness, and diversity use 39 ChatGPT and 28 Google Search participants with valid ideas; productivity and efficiency use all 45 retained participants per arm. No extraction errors or missing eligible outcomes or contrasts were found. Tables 4-5 and A1-A5 adjust for post-treatment variables and are correctly excluded. The TF-IDF robustness statement supplies no additional numerical contrast. The printed novelty difference of 0.018 conflicts with its arm means, and Table 2 contains inconsistent outcome summaries; these source-paper issues are already documented and correctly preserved without invented corrections. Unreported arm SDs, SEs, confidence intervals, and F degrees of freedom remain null.
